title: Create
text: Direct Create connections let Mana Engines provide stress at a fixed 16 rpm, converting configured pulse potential into capacity. Engine controls show potential; Create components show rotation and stress.

Stress is occupied, not consumed. Native machines prioritize pulses; external kinetic drive has fixed total occupancy and does not accelerate with RPM. Crystal and Infused Crystal Casings cover kinetic components and pipes. Spacetime Ports connect real shafts across different orientations.
